title: Tapo 2K 4MP Smart Wire-Free Security Camera And Solar Panel Kit $104 via Special Order + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Bunnings Warehouse
body:
Deal: Tapo 2K 4MP Smart Wire-Free Security Camera And Solar Panel Kit $104 via Special Order + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Bunnings Warehouse

[Gavy1370] The Tapo C425 is a premium, wider-angle security camera with a larger battery and magnetic base. The Tapo C410 is an entry-level alternative with a longer battery life (but smaller total capacity), more compact size, and a narrower field of view
[gtech] IMHO the only killer feature that the more premium cameras have is always record, where it's recoding always but only 'saving' (-15sec) after motion has been detected. This ensures that you are not missing 10-20 seconds of footage before detection starts. Not too sure if this camera has this.
[Weshouldgetsushi] I found this problem with a few solar battery powered cameras. Always missing the first bit.
Went back to mains/usb powered.
[euro33] We have a few of these outside - they are solid cameras. Resolution is good, not amazing, but that's 2K.
[EarlyBird] Do they miss the first few seconds of recording after motion is detected?
[euro33] Hmm not sure but I think they do… I dial up the detection range so it's not an issue
[mewx] wow, it's a pretty good deal! The camera is pretty good. I got a few at $140 previously
[Krayzii] Anyone tried this with a gutter mount? Don't wanna drill brick
[euro33] Can't be gutter mounted without drilling
[Sfh1975] Might be possible. check those adapters on ebay or aliexpress.
